_comment: Template for AgentCore Gateway target registration. Replace LAMBDA_ARN with the actual ARN from the OpenClawAgentCoreTools stack output (DeployStaticSiteLambdaArn).

inlinePayload.name: deploy_static_site
inlinePayload.description: Deploy a static website to AWS. Creates an S3 bucket for hosting and a CloudFront distribution for HTTPS delivery. Provide the site name and HTML content. Returns the CloudFront URL where the site will be accessible within 5-10 minutes.

site_name.description: A short name for the website (e.g., 'my-portfolio', 'landing-page'). Used to name the S3 bucket.

html_content.description: The HTML content for the website's index page. Can be a full HTML document or a simple HTML snippet.

index_document.description: The filename for the index page. Defaults to 'index.html'.

inlinePayload.name: list_deployed_sites
inlinePayload.description: List all static websites that have been deployed by the agent. Returns the S3 bucket names of all agent-deployed sites.

inlinePayload.name: delete_static_site
inlinePayload.description: Delete an agent-deployed static website. Removes the S3 bucket and all its contents. Only works on agent-deployed resources (prefixed with 'agent-').

bucket_name.description: The S3 bucket name of the site to delete. Must start with 'agent-'.
